identity_rule: provider family, rendered service, and retained source dataset are distinct manifestations; name/proximity/category never establish source identity

providers.resolution: zoom-dependent; not an analytical resolution claim

providers.temporal_coverage: mosaic/source-dependent; exact imagery date must be read from service metadata for any observation
providers.resolution: source/mosaic-dependent; no single federation resolution asserted
providers.retention: UNRESOLVED_FOR_THIS_EXACT_LEGACY_ENDPOINT; do not persist tiles as evidence

fallback_policy.principle: fallback changes presentation only; it never changes canonical geometry, entity identity, source evidence, or retained observations
fail_closed: never persist commercial-render pixels unless explicit source terms permit it
never infer historical acquisition date from a current mosaic
never promote rendered visual coincidence to identity
never substitute a fallback provider for an authoritative retained source

open_residue: complete exhaustive repository manifestation inventory beyond bounded code-search discoveries
bind exact Esri World Imagery service/item terms and current authentication requirements
bind exact Puerto Rico NAIP assets/epochs and rights metadata
bind exact USGS/NOAA aerial datasets used by Skywatcher calibration
adjudicate Google historical imagery use separately if retained observations are required
freeze mutable external terms/service manifests with retrieval hashes
